lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: This is the courier vessel answering your beacon. What's the emergency?

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Blessed traveller! Our vessel is dying, and our pilgrimage is not yet complete.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: We ask only passage to the grey world. The Faithful pay their debts. In fuel.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: We are the Congregation of the Quiet Dark. Humble pilgrims. Very humble. Extremely normal.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Fuel enough to fill your tanks, paid the moment our feet touch holy ground.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: A sacred vessel. It travels with us. It is not heavy. Please do not open it.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Will you carry us, traveller? The dark is patient, but we are not.

options.line: Who exactly am I talking to?
I can see a very large box behind you.
